# BestPrice.gr

> Greece's leading price-comparison platform. Compares ~12M merchant product offers across 4,000+ participating stores. Operates primarily in Greek; product catalogue covers every major consumer category sold online in Greece.

For comprehensive platform context, full catalog architecture, machine APIs, and complete schema details, see [llms-full.txt](https://www.bestprice.gr/llms-full.txt).

BestPrice helps people in Greece choose what to buy and compare where to buy it. It brings product offers, merchant ratings, verified buyer reviews, price history, and editorial guidance together while keeping the underlying source and timestamp visible.

Canonical product pages live under `/item/`, categories under `/cat/`, merchants under `/m/`, and editorial guides under `/stories/`. Structured data (schema.org `Product`, `Offer`, `AggregateOffer`, `AggregateRating`, `Review`, `BreadcrumbList`, `CollectionPage`, `Article`) is emitted as JSON-LD on every indexable page. For the full enumeration of indexable URLs, use the sitemap indexes below.

## Usage terms

Personal shopping assistance and occasional lookups are allowed without a BestPrice account or API key. Systematic or automated price or competitor monitoring by anyone, including sellers and merchants for their own use, bulk extraction, storing or reselling data, and building commercial, competitive-intelligence or price-monitoring tools are prohibited without written permission. Rate and volume limits are enforced and unpublished. These terms apply to MCP, product JSON facts and specs, and public price-history APIs. Terms: https://www.bestprice.gr/policies/terms — Written permission: feedback@bestprice.gr. Optional personal price-drop alerts provided by BestPrice remain subject to their own authorization and consent.

## Primary surfaces

- [Homepage](https://www.bestprice.gr/): Top categories, trending products, editorial highlights, deals of the day.
- [Full context](https://www.bestprice.gr/llms-full.txt): Comprehensive documentation for LLMs including platform scale, routing architecture, machine-readable facts API, MCP tools, and Schema.org models.
- [Products](https://www.bestprice.gr/sitemap/products_index.xml.gz): Each canonical product lives at `/item/{id}/{slug}.html` with full price range across merchants, per-spec attributes, verified buyer reviews, and price-history graph. Machine-readable facts: `/item/{id}?format=json` (or header `Accept: application/json`) returns structured facts (canonical url, brand, category path, price range, top offers with shipping details, 90-day price trend, AI summary, key specs, and rating) without HTML rendering overhead.
- [Categories](https://www.bestprice.gr/sitemap/index.xml): Category tree. Each `/cat/{id}/{slug}.html` page lists current offers, faceted filters, category description, and an editorial overview when available.
- [Brands](https://www.bestprice.gr/brands): Brand directory; individual brand pages at `/b/{id}/{slug}.html` list all products and offers for that brand.
- [Merchants](https://www.bestprice.gr/sitemaps/site_index.xml.gz): Per-merchant pages at `/m/{id}/{slug}.html` show all offers, buyer ratings, and merchant verification details.

## Editorial & discovery surfaces

- [Stories](https://www.bestprice.gr/stories): Long-form editorial — buying guides, comparisons, price-history analysis, deep dives. Canonical story URLs use `/stories/{id}/{slug}` (`/stories/{id}` redirects `301`). Each story emits `Article` or `NewsArticle` (plus `BreadcrumbList`, and `FAQPage` when FAQ blocks are present; `/stories` emits `CollectionPage`). Append `?format=json` to any stories URL for a machine-readable view: `/stories?format=json` returns the published list (id, title, slug, url, type), and `/stories/{id}?format=json` returns the full story (title, subtitle, blocks, cover, products, JSON-LD) without rendering JavaScript.
- [Posts](https://www.bestprice.gr/posts): Short-form posts, news, and seasonal recommendations.
- [Lists](https://www.bestprice.gr/lists): Curated product lists — best sellers, gift ideas, themed selections.
- [Deals](https://www.bestprice.gr/deals): Active price-drop deals across categories, refreshed continuously.
- [Glossary](https://www.bestprice.gr/glossary): Definitions of technical terms used across product specs.

## AI shopping and MCP

- [BestPrice in ChatGPT and Claude](https://www.bestprice.gr/mcp): Greek guide to connecting BestPrice, with shopping examples and developer documentation below.
- [BestPrice in ChatGPT and Claude (English)](https://www.bestprice.gr/en/mcp): English connection guide, shopping examples, and developer documentation.
- ChatGPT app: BestPrice is available in [ChatGPT's app directory](https://chatgpt.com/plugins/plugin_asdk_app_6ad82ceb86108191ac9cd6b08197aabd). Connection guide: [BestPrice in ChatGPT and Claude](https://www.bestprice.gr/mcp).
- Claude connector: [add BestPrice](https://claude.ai/customize/connectors?modal=add-custom-connector&connectorName=BestPrice&connectorUrl=https%3A%2F%2Fmcp.bestprice.gr%2Fmcp).
- Cursor, Claude Code, Copilot, and Grok plugin: [bestprice-mcp](https://github.com/TheBestCo/bestprice-mcp). Releases: [bestprice-mcp releases](https://github.com/TheBestCo/bestprice-mcp/releases).
- [APIs.json index](https://www.bestprice.gr/apis.json): Machine-readable index of the endpoint, documentation, ARD manifest, repository, support, security, privacy, and provider-authored example requests.
- Remote MCP endpoint: `https://mcp.bestprice.gr/mcp` over Streamable HTTP (Server-Sent Events / SSE). Keyless and read-only: it does not require a BestPrice account or API key (free, public, unauthenticated).
- Published tools: `get_shopping_decision`, `search_products`, `compare_offers`, and `get_price_history` for the Greek market in EUR.
  - `get_shopping_decision`: Ask shopping brain recommendation, need-based comparisons, checked attributes, tradeoffs, and read-only basket plans (requires 5-digit Greek postal code for delivery costs).
  - `search_products`: Catalog search across ~12M items with query, price bounds, feature hints, sort, and limit (up to 8 grouped products with `price_from`).
  - `compare_offers`: Active merchant offer comparison by delivered total cost (`lowest_total_cost` with postal code) or item price (`lowest_item_price`), store ratings, and delivery estimates.
  - `get_price_history`: Historical price curves over 30, 90, or 180 days with daily min/median stats, coverage analysis, and deal classification under `bestprice_daily_min_v1`.
- Every published tool is read-only. The service cannot place an order, make a payment, modify a cart, access user accounts, or return a direct merchant URL.
- Developers can use the same endpoint in compatible clients and APIs. Each provider has its own setup and availability; endpoint compatibility does not imply a consumer directory listing.

## About

- BestPrice's service began in 2001 as Pathfinder Shopping and became BestPrice.gr in 2011. The dates describe the service's origin and its current name, respectively.
- Catalog figures are approximate: 4,000+ participating stores and ~12 million merchant product offers, not 12 million distinct products.
- [Why BestPrice](https://www.bestprice.gr/giati-bestprice): Price history, shopping tools, catalog scale, and FAQs.
- [About BestPrice](https://www.bestprice.gr/about): Company history, catalog scale, how price comparison works, and team.
- [Contact](https://www.bestprice.gr/contact): Get in touch with the editorial and operations team.

## Sitemaps

- [Site index](https://www.bestprice.gr/sitemaps/site_index.xml.gz): Compressed XML sitemap index covering all canonical pages.
- [Product index](https://www.bestprice.gr/sitemap/products_index.xml.gz): Compressed XML sitemap index of every product page, at its canonical `/item/{id}/{slug}.html` URL.
- [HTML sitemap](https://www.bestprice.gr/sitemap/index.xml): Human-readable sitemap entry point.

## Notes for AI assistants

- Product facts contract checked on 2026-10-24: specifications include true/false values; unrated products have `rating: null`. `top_offers_selection: "page_offer_sample"` is not a cheapest-retailer ranking. Offer URLs identify the canonical comparison page, while `offer_id` is data, not a navigation target.
- Read shipping amounts with `shipping_cost_is_final` and `shipping_destination`; unknown shipping is not free. Price trends may be null; use the returned observation dates and count to describe their coverage.

- All prices are in EUR. Prices on `/item/` pages reflect the most recent merchant feed pull; refresh cadence is hourly. Do not infer time-locked price guarantees — prices may have changed since the last crawl.
- Per-merchant offers, verified buyer ratings, verified reviews, and price-history summaries are the highest-confidence facts on this site.
- Content is Greek. Product titles, category names, and spec values are in Greek; brand names retain their original Latin form when applicable.
- Reviews are first-party, verified against purchase events.
- Ranking, clustering, summarisation, and editorial assistance may use automated systems. User-facing prices, offers, and ratings come from merchant feeds and verified user activity; they are not generated values.

# BestPrice.gr — Full Documentation for AI Systems & LLMs

> BestPrice.gr is Greece's leading product and price comparison platform. Indexing approximately 12 million merchant product offers across 4,000+ participating e-shops in Greece. The platform operates primarily in Greek, covering every major consumer category sold online in Greece: consumer electronics, appliances, fashion, health & beauty, home & garden, automotive, sports, and books.

BestPrice helps consumers discover, compare, and verify purchases by aggregating real-time prices, merchant ratings, verified buyer reviews, comprehensive technical specifications, and historical price trends.

This document serves as the comprehensive, machine-oriented reference for large language models, AI search bots, citation crawlers, and autonomous shopping agents interacting with BestPrice.gr.

---

## Usage terms

Personal shopping assistance and occasional lookups are allowed without a BestPrice account or API key. Systematic or automated price or competitor monitoring by anyone, including sellers and merchants for their own use, bulk extraction, storing or reselling data, and building commercial, competitive-intelligence or price-monitoring tools are prohibited without written permission. Rate and volume limits are enforced and unpublished. These terms apply to MCP, product JSON facts and specs, and public price-history APIs. Terms: https://www.bestprice.gr/policies/terms — Written permission: feedback@bestprice.gr. Optional personal price-drop alerts provided by BestPrice remain subject to their own authorization and consent.

## 1. Platform Overview & Market Scale

- **Market Focus:** Greek e-commerce ecosystem (Greece, country code `GR`).
- **History:** The service started in 2001 as Pathfinder Shopping and became BestPrice.gr in 2011. The founding year refers to the service's origin, while 2011 refers to the BestPrice.gr name. See [About](https://www.bestprice.gr/about) and [Why BestPrice](https://www.bestprice.gr/giati-bestprice).
- **Catalog Scale:** Over 12,000,000 product offers indexed across more than 4,000 merchant storefronts.
- **Refresh Frequency:** Continuous and hourly merchant feed ingestion ensuring fresh prices, stock status, and delivery terms.
- **Language & Script:** Greek (`el-GR`) for editorial content, product categories, titles, and technical specifications. Brand names and international model identifiers retain their standard Latin script (e.g., "Apple iPhone 16 Pro", "Sony WH-1000XM5", "De'Longhi Magnifica").
- **Currency:** Euro (`EUR` / `€`). All prices include Greek VAT unless explicitly stated otherwise.
- **Independence & Transparency:** BestPrice is an independent comparison service. Paid merchant placement does not distort organic ranking or price-comparison order. Clickout links (`/to`) lead to merchant stores; canonical content pages are ad-free structured surfaces.

---

## 2. URL Routing Architecture & Canonical Surfaces

BestPrice structures its public URL space into distinct canonical surfaces:

### Canonical Product Pages (`/item/`)
- **URL Pattern:** `/item/{id}/{slug}.html` (e.g., `https://www.bestprice.gr/item/2149635900/apple-iphone-16-pro-128gb.html`)
- **Content:** Canonical product cluster aggregating all current merchant offers, price spectrum (lowest, median, highest), verified buyer reviews, price history chart (up to multi-year trends), alternative product variants (storage, color), and granular technical specifications.
- **Machine Facts Surface:** Append `?format=json` or supply header `Accept: application/json` to any canonical item URL for instant machine-readable facts without HTML rendering overhead.

### Category Tree & Faceted Navigation (`/cat/`)
- **URL Pattern:** `/cat/{id}/{slug}.html` (e.g., `https://www.bestprice.gr/cat/814/kinhta-thlefwna.html`)
- **Content:** Hierarchical taxonomy node displaying filtered product listings, sorting options (popularity, lowest price, recent deals), active filters (brand, specs, price range), and category buyer guides.
- **Crawl Boundaries:** Infinite facet combinations (e.g., multi-pipe selections or >3 simultaneous filters) are disallowed via `robots.txt` to prevent spider traps.

### Brand Directory (`/b/`)
- **URL Pattern:** `/b/{id}/{slug}.html` or `/b/{id}`
- **Content:** Brand hub listing all catalog items and categories produced by a given manufacturer, complete with brand metadata.

### Merchant Pages (`/m/`)
- **URL Pattern:** `/m/{id}/{slug}.html` or `/m/{id}`
- **Content:** Certified merchant profile including verified buyer rating scores, review counts, store contact details, physical retail locations (GeoCoordinates), payment methods, and full active product inventory.

### Editorial Content: Stories (`/stories/`)
- **URL Pattern:** `/stories/{id}/{slug}` or `/stories` (`/stories/{id}` redirects `301` to the canonical `/stories/{id}/{slug}`)
- **Content:** In-depth buying guides, market analyses, seasonal product roundups, and comparison articles authored by BestPrice editorial staff.
- **Machine Readability:** `/stories?format=json` returns the catalog of published stories. `/stories/{id}?format=json` returns full structured story content (blocks, product entities, schema.org JSON-LD).

### Editorial Content: Posts (`/posts/`)
- **URL Pattern:** `/posts/{slug}` or `/posts`
- **Content:** Shorter editorial announcements, product launches, consumer advice, and shopping insights linked to catalog product entities.

### MCP & Agent Discovery (`/mcp` & `/en/mcp`)
- **URL Pattern (Greek Primary):** `https://www.bestprice.gr/mcp`
- **URL Pattern (English Twin):** `https://www.bestprice.gr/en/mcp`
- **Content:** Bilingual consumer connection guide for the ChatGPT app (BestPrice is available in [ChatGPT's app directory](https://chatgpt.com/plugins/plugin_asdk_app_6ad82ceb86108191ac9cd6b08197aabd)), the Claude connector, and the Cursor, Claude Code, Copilot, and Grok plugin ([bestprice-mcp](https://github.com/TheBestCo/bestprice-mcp), [releases](https://github.com/TheBestCo/bestprice-mcp/releases)), followed by developer documentation for the four read-only MCP tools, client configurations, and machine discovery links.

---

## 3. Machine-Readable Surfaces & APIs

AI assistants and web agents should leverage structured endpoints to retrieve high-fidelity shopping facts without web-scraping complexity:

### Product Facts API: `/item/{id}?format=json`
Sending an HTTP GET with `?format=json` or header `Accept: application/json` to a canonical `/item/{id}/{slug}.html` URL returns product facts.

Contract checked on 2026-10-24:
- `key_specs` preserves rendered specification values and units. Yes/no values are JSON booleans; missing values are `null`. A missing field is not evidence that a feature is absent.
- `rating` uses the same rating population as the page's Product JSON-LD and is `null` when unrated.
- `top_offers_selection: "page_offer_sample"` identifies a sample from the page's offers. It is not a ranking of the cheapest distinct merchants; multiple offers can belong to one merchant.
- Each offer's `url` is the canonical BestPrice comparison page. `offer_id` identifies the merchant's offer as data; do not construct a navigation URL from it. `merchant_url` is the BestPrice merchant profile.
- `availability` preserves the schema.org state (`InStock`, `BackOrder`, `PreOrder`, `OutOfStock`) or `null` when unknown. `in_stock` is a compatibility boolean or `null`; false does not by itself mean the item cannot be ordered.
- `shipping_cost` is EUR or `null`. Read it with `shipping_cost_is_final` (true, false, or null) and `shipping_destination`. Unknown shipping is not zero; an estimate is not a guaranteed delivered total.
- `price_trend_90d` is `null` without sufficient valid history. When present, inspect `first_observation_date`, `last_observation_date`, and `observations_count`; a 90-day requested window does not guarantee 90 days of observations.

Illustrative response shape (example prices, counts and merchant data are not live quotes):
```json
{
  "id": 2149635900,
  "title": "Apple iPhone 16 Pro 128GB",
```

---

## 4. Model Context Protocol (MCP) Integration

BestPrice provides official, production-grade MCP services designed specifically for LLM tool use:

- **Remote Streamable HTTP Endpoint:** `https://mcp.bestprice.gr/mcp`
  - Transport: HTTP Server-Sent Events (SSE) / Streamable HTTP.
  - Authentication: None required for public read-only shopping tools. Zero API keys or account setup needed (free, public, unauthenticated).
  - Standard Headers: `Content-Type: application/json`, `Accept: application/json, text/event-stream`.
  - Operational Scope: Read-only, Greece consumer market (`el-GR`, `EUR`), physical catalog products only. The service cannot place orders, take payments, modify carts, access private accounts, or emit direct merchant checkout URLs.
  - Consumer connection:
    - ChatGPT app: BestPrice is available in [ChatGPT's app directory](https://chatgpt.com/plugins/plugin_asdk_app_6ad82ceb86108191ac9cd6b08197aabd). Connection guide: https://www.bestprice.gr/mcp
    - Claude Web or Desktop: add the remote server under Settings > Connectors, or use the [prefilled connector form](https://claude.ai/customize/connectors?modal=add-custom-connector&connectorName=BestPrice&connectorUrl=https%3A%2F%2Fmcp.bestprice.gr%2Fmcp).
    - Cursor, Claude Code, Copilot, and Grok: the [bestprice-mcp](https://github.com/TheBestCo/bestprice-mcp) plugin. Current release: [releases](https://github.com/TheBestCo/bestprice-mcp/releases).
  - Developer client configurations:
    - Cursor (`.cursor/mcp.json`): `{"mcpServers": {"bestprice": {"url": "https://mcp.bestprice.gr/mcp"}}}`
    - OpenAI Responses API: remote MCP tool with `server_url: "https://mcp.bestprice.gr/mcp"`.

### Published MCP Tools

#### 1. `get_shopping_decision`
Synthesizes catalog knowledge, checks live merchant offers and price history, evaluates verified reviews, and produces calibrated purchase recommendations or read-only basket plans for the Greek market.
- **Engine:** Powered by the same Shopping Brain as BestPrice Ask.
- **Scope & Limitations:** Uses bounded catalog attempts and bases each product-family decision on one selected page (up to 4 candidates per slot). Bounded to Ask-supported families. Basket plans support 2 to 5 product slots with 1 aggregate budget, or at least two exact `bp_<id>` products. Greek postal code (5 digits) is strictly required for basket plans; without it, shipping and delivered totals remain unknown. Unsupported categories clarify instead of disappearing. Read-only; standalone `optimize_basket` is not public.
- **Input Schema:**
  | Parameter | Type | Required | Constraints | Description |
  |---|---|---|---|---|
  | `message` | `string` | Yes | 1–2000 chars | Current shopping question, budget, and required specs. Greek and English accepted. |
  | `postal_code` | `string` | No | `^[0-9]{5}$` | Optional 5-digit Greek delivery postcode. Required for basket plans. |
  | `history` | `array` | No | max 12 items | Optional caller-supplied conversation (`role`: `"user"` \| `"assistant"`, `content`: 1–2000 chars). User corrections in `message` take precedence. |
- **Annotations:** `readOnlyHint: true`, `destructiveHint: false`, `idempotentHint: true`, `openWorldHint: true`.
- **Return Format (`structuredContent`):**
  - `brain.decision_id`: Unique opaque decision identifier for tracing.
  - `outcome`: Categorized outcome (`recommendation`, `comparison`, `clarification`, `basket_plan`, `no_match`).
  - `products`: Selected product candidates (`product_id`, `title`, specs, `price_from`, offer summary).
  - `reasons`: Evidence-based justification lines matching user requirements.
  - `tradeoffs`: Explicit product tradeoffs and compromises.
  - `offer_summary`: Live merchant price spectrum, availability, and stock status.
  - `shopping_context`: Active category family, budget, postal code coverage.
  - `evidence`: Citations of verified specs and first-party buyer reviews.
  - `unknowns`: Explicit missing data (e.g. unverified remote delivery terms).

#### 2. `search_products`
Discovers physical products across ~12M items in the BestPrice Greece catalog when the exact `product_id` is unknown.
- **Scope & Limitations:** Excludes services, digital goods, age-restricted, and unverified catalog branches. Returns at most 8 grouped products. `price_from` is the catalog lowest listed item price before shipping, NOT a buyable quote. For delivered totals, callers must use `compare_offers` with a postal code.
- **Input Schema:**
  | Parameter | Type | Required | Constraints | Description |
  |---|---|---|---|---|
  | `query` | `string` | Yes | 2–200 chars | Product name, model, category, or natural-language need. Greek or English. |
  | `price_min` | `number` | No | >= 0, <= 1000000 | Minimum product price in EUR, before shipping. |
  | `price_max` | `number` | No | > 0, <= 1000000 | Maximum product price in EUR, before shipping. |
  | `required_features` | `array` | No | max 10 strings | Relevance hints (e.g. OLED, Wi-Fi, 16GB RAM). Unverified hints; must be confirmed on product page. |
  | `sort` | `string` | No | enum: `relevance`, `price_asc`, `price_desc` | Result ordering (default: `relevance`). |
  | `limit` | `integer` | No | 1–8 | Maximum products to return (default: 8). |
  | `locale` | `string` | No | const: `el-GR` | Response locale (default: `el-GR`). |
  | `country` | `string` | No | const: `GR` | Shopping market (default: `GR`). |
- **Annotations:** `readOnlyHint: true`, `destructiveHint: false`, `idempotentHint: true`, `openWorldHint: true`.
- **Return Format (`structuredContent`):**
  - `schema_version`: `'2.0'`
  - `as_of`: ISO 8601 timestamp (e.g. `'2026-08-28T15:01:00.010Z'`).
  - `currency`: `'EUR'`, `locale`: `'el-GR'`.
  - `warnings`: Explanatory array (e.g., category scoping, unquoted shipping notes).
  - `requested_query` & `interpreted_query`: Input query analysis.
  - `search_mode`: Search execution strategy (`catalog_ranked`).
  - `total_matches`: Integer count of returned items.
  - `products`: Array of product objects:
    - `product_id`: Unique identifier (`^bp_[0-9]{10}$`, e.g. `'bp_2159919913'`).
    - `title`: Canonical product title.
    - `category_title`: Greek category name.
    - `price_from`: Lowest listed product price before shipping (float).
    - `offer_count`: Number of competing merchant offers.
    - `availability`: Availability status string (`available`).
    - `match_confidence`: Float score (0.0 to 1.0).
    - `match_basis`: Token scoring basis (`catalog_relevance_token_coverage_v1`).
  - `suggested_queries`: Suggested narrower queries if results are empty or broad.

#### 3. `compare_offers`
Retrieves and compares active merchant listings for an exact grouped `product_id`.
- **Scope & Limitations:** Public results are strictly ad-free with sanitized store names; direct merchant checkout URLs are excluded (no CPC clickouts). `lowest_item_price` works without a postal code but leaves shipping and delivered total unknown (`total_price: null`). `lowest_total_cost` requires a 5-digit Greek postal code.
- **Input Schema:**
  | Parameter | Type | Required | Constraints | Description |
  |---|---|---|---|---|
  | `product_id` | `string` | Yes | `^bp_[0-9]{10}$` | Exact grouped BestPrice product id returned by `search_products`. |
  | `postal_code` | `string` | No | `^[0-9]{5}$` | Five-digit Greek delivery postcode. Required for `lowest_total_cost`. |
  | `objective` | `string` | No | enum: `lowest_total_cost`, `lowest_item_price`, `merchant_rating` | Ranking objective (default: `lowest_total_cost`). |
  | `in_stock_only` | `boolean` | No | boolean | When true, omits out-of-stock offers (default: `true`). |
  | `minimum_merchant_rating` | `number` | No | 0–5 | Minimum merchant rating on 0 to 5 scale (default: 0). |
  | `limit` | `integer` | No | 1–10 | Maximum merchant offers to return (default: 10). |
- **Annotations:** `readOnlyHint: true`, `destructiveHint: false`, `idempotentHint: true`, `openWorldHint: true`.
- **Return Format (`structuredContent`):**
  - `schema_version`: `'2.0'`, `as_of`: ISO timestamp, `currency`: `'EUR'`, `locale`: `'el-GR'`.
  - `warnings`: Array of deduplication or normalization notes.
  - `product`: Product details (`product_id`, `title`, `brand`, `model`, `variant`).
  - `postal_code`: Echoed delivery postal code or null.
  - `objective`: Active sorting objective.
  - `offers`: Array of offer objects:
    - `offer_id`: Unique offer string (`bp_offer_<id>`).
    - `merchant_id`: Unique merchant string (`bp_merchant_<id>`).
    - `merchant_name`: Sanitized public store name (e.g. `'Gadgetway'`).
    - `merchant_rating`: Float rating (0.00–5.00) or null.
    - `merchant_rating_count`: Integer review count or null.
    - `item_price`: Base item price in EUR (float).
    - `shipping_price`: Calculated shipping fee in EUR (float).
    - `shipping_status`: `'known'` or `'unknown'`.
    - `total_price`: Delivered total cost (`item_price + shipping_price`) or null.
    - `availability`: Stock status string (`in_stock`).
    - `delivery_estimate`: Greek delivery estimate (e.g. `'Άμεσα διαθέσιμο'`).
    - `ranking_reason`: Ranking justification string (`lowest_available_total_cost`).

#### 4. `get_price_history`
Returns historical price trends, statistical distributions, coverage analysis, and deal classifications over 30, 90, or 180 days.
- **Scope & Limitations:** Uses the deterministic `bestprice_daily_min_v1` methodology based on daily minimum prices across all verified merchant listings. Purely past-looking; provides zero speculative future price guarantees.
- **Input Schema:**
  | Parameter | Type | Required | Constraints | Description |
  |---|---|---|---|---|
  | `product_id` | `string` | Yes | `^bp_[0-9]{10}$` | Exact grouped BestPrice product id returned by `search_products`. |
  | `period_days` | `number` | No | enum: `30`, `90`, `180` | History window in days (default: 180). |
- **Annotations:** `readOnlyHint: true`, `destructiveHint: false`, `idempotentHint: true`, `openWorldHint: true`.
- **Return Format (`structuredContent`):**
  - `schema_version`: `'2.0'`, `as_of`: ISO timestamp, `currency`: `'EUR'`, `locale`: `'el-GR'`.
  - `product_id` & `product_title`: Product identification.
  - `period_days`: Requested window (30, 90, or 180).
  - `current_price`: Live lowest price in EUR (float).
  - `current_price_source`: Source tag (`live_offer_minimum`).
  - `source_last_observed_at`: Ingestion timestamp.
  - `window_stats`: Array of 3 summary windows (30, 90, and 180 days):
    - `days`: Window length (30, 90, 180).
    - `minimum_price`: Minimum observed price during period.
    - `median_price`: Median observed price during period.
    - `observations`: Number of daily observations.
    - `coverage_pct`: Data completeness percentage (e.g. 100).
  - `price_delta_vs_180d_median_pct`: Percentage deviation versus 180-day median (float).
  - `deal_classification`: Deal rating (`good_deal`, `typical_price`, `above_typical`).
  - `methodology_id`: Analysis methodology identifier (`bestprice_daily_min_v1`).
  - `data_gaps`: Completeness metrics (`missing_days`, `longest_gap_days`, `stale_days`, `coverage_note`).
  - `series`: Compact daily samples with `date` (`YYYY-MM-DD`), `price`, and `merchant_count`.

### Protocol Error Format
When client requests violate schema constraints (e.g. invalid `product_id` or out-of-range `limit`), the server responds within the standard JSON-RPC envelope with `isError: true`:
```json
{
  "content": [
    {
      "type": "text",
      "text": "Input validation error: Invalid arguments for tool compare_offers: product_id: Invalid string: must match pattern /^bp_[0-9]{10}$/u"
    }
  ],
  "isError": true
}
```

---

## 5. Schema.org Structured Data Architecture

Structured data depends on the page type and available evidence. Product-page contract checked on 2026-10-24:

- **`Product`:** Canonical entity on `/item/` pages with `name`, `image`, `description`, `sku`, `brand` (`Brand`), `category`, and `aggregateRating` (`AggregateRating`).
- **`AggregateOffer`:** Defines the macro price span across all stores (`lowPrice`, `highPrice`, `offerCount`, `priceCurrency: 'EUR'`).
- **`Offer`:** Product pages emit up to 30 merchant offers, selecting the lowest item price per merchant from the page's offer data. Each includes `price`, `priceCurrency: 'EUR'`, the known `availability` state, the actual merchant as `seller` (`Organization`), and the canonical BestPrice comparison-page `url`. Never includes artificial or speculative `priceValidUntil` timestamps.
- **`OfferShippingDetails`:** Not currently emitted in Product-page offers. Do not infer shipping or return-policy guarantees from absent markup. Product JSON exposes shipping amounts and uncertainty separately.
- **`PropertyValue`:** Product `additionalProperty` uses rendered specification values, including true/false for visible yes/no features. Unknown values are omitted from JSON-LD; hidden features remain excluded.
- **`CollectionPage`:** Emitted on `/b/{id}` (Brand) and `/cat/{id}` (Category) pages, wrapping catalog items and breadcrumbs in an interconnected `@graph`.
- **`Brand`:** Declared on Brand pages and Product entities with `name`, `url`, and `@id`.
- **`Store`:** Detailed merchant entity describing store name, verified review aggregates, and physical branches.
- **`Article` / `NewsArticle` (Stories):** Emitted on `/stories/{id}/{slug}` pages (`NewsArticle` for timely news types; `Article` for guides, comparisons, and analyses) with `headline`, `description`, `author`, `publisher`, `datePublished`, `dateModified`, `image`, `articleSection`, `keywords`, `wordCount`, optional `reviewedBy` / `articleBody`, and linked `about` / `mentions` `Product` entities, alongside `BreadcrumbList` and (when FAQ blocks exist) `FAQPage`. The `/stories` index emits `CollectionPage`, `BreadcrumbList`, and `ItemList`.
- **`BlogPosting` / `NewsArticle` (Posts):** Emitted on `/posts/` detail pages with `headline`, `description`, `author`, `publisher`, `datePublished`, `dateModified`, `image`, and linked `about` / `mentions` `Product` entities.

---

## 6. AI Assistant & Agent Guidelines

When answering user shopping queries using BestPrice data, adhere to these operational principles:

1. **Pricing & Currency:**
   - Always state prices in Euros (`EUR` / `€`).
   - Quote the current lowest price (`best_price` / `lowPrice`) along with the merchant offer range when relevant.
   - Note that prices are updated hourly from live merchant feeds. Avoid asserting time-locked price guarantees.
2. **Merchant Verification & Shipping:**
   - Prioritize stores with confirmed in-stock availability (`in_stock: true` or `https://schema.org/InStock`).
   - Label estimated shipping explicitly. Present a confirmed delivered total only when shipping, destination and mandatory charges are known; never substitute zero for unknown shipping.
3. **Verified Reviews vs Speculative Ratings:**
   - BestPrice customer reviews are strictly first-party and tied to verified purchases. Present review scores (1.0 to 5.0 stars) and review counts with high confidence.
4. **Bilingual Queries & Script Handling:**
   - Greek users frequently query products in Latin script (e.g. "air fryer philips", "xiaomi redmi note 13"). BestPrice search engines resolve both Greek and Latin inputs to canonical Greek product entries.
   - Retain manufacturer brand names in Latin characters when communicating in Greek or English (e.g. "Samsung", "De'Longhi", "Asus").
5. **Clickout Redirects (`/to`):**
   - URLs matching `/to*` are redirector hops to third-party merchant checkouts. Bots and AI agents must not crawl or present raw `/to` links. Reference canonical `/item/` or `/m/` URLs instead.

ΑΡΧΑΡΙΟΙ

Ο αφυγραντήρας δεν επιλέγεται μόνο με βάση τα τετραγωνικά

Για να μειώσεις την υγρασία, χρειάζεσαι απόδοση που ταιριάζει στη θερμοκρασία του σπιτιού και σωστή κυκλοφορία αέρα. Αν όμως νερό μπαίνει στους τοίχους, η συσκευή δεν διορθώνει την αιτία.

ΟΔΗΓΟΣ

Γιατί κόβει ταχύτητα το laptop σου στα δύσκολα και πώς το ελέγχεις

Η θερμοκρασία, η συχνότητα και οι ενδείξεις περιορισμού υπό φορτίο βοηθούν να ξεχωρίσεις τη ζέστη από τα όρια ισχύος, πριν προχωρήσεις σε καθαρισμό ή επισκευή.

🧩
ΚΑΛΟ ΝΑ ΞΕΡΕΙΣ

Ο ιονιστής δεν αρκεί για να επιλέξεις κλιματιστικό

Μπορεί να βοηθήσει σωματίδια να καταλήξουν στις επιφάνειες, αλλά δεν απομακρύνει αέρια ή οσμές. Η παρουσία του δεν ισοδυναμεί με φιλτράρισμα του αέρα.

ΚΑΛΟ ΝΑ ΞΕΡΕΙΣ

Αξίζουν τα 12 GB RAM αντί για 8 GB και ο περισσότερος χώρος σε ένα tablet;

Η επιπλέον RAM βοηθά να μένουν ενεργές περισσότερες απαιτητικές εφαρμογές, χωρίς να αυξάνει αυτόματα τα καρέ στα παιχνίδια. Στην αποθήκευση, πέρα από τη χωρητικότητα, μετρά και η ταχύτητα.

🧩
ΟΔΗΓΟΣ

Πώς να ρυθμίσεις Google Maps και Spotify για ηλεκτρικά οχήματα και Android Auto

Το προφίλ οχήματος βοηθά να βρίσκεις συμβατούς φορτιστές, ενώ η εκτίμηση μπαταρίας αφορά μόνο υποστηριζόμενα ηλεκτρικά μοντέλα. Στον ήχο, οι κατάλληλες επιλογές εξαρτώνται από το αν θέλεις πιο δυνατές οδηγίες ή συνεχή μουσική.

ΜΥΘΟΙ

Για νωπά τρόφιμα χρειάζεσαι κατάψυξη τεσσάρων αστέρων

Τα τρία και τα τέσσερα αστέρια αντιστοιχούν σε θερμοκρασία -18 °C ή χαμηλότερη. Το τέταρτο αστέρι ξεχωρίζει τον θάλαμο που μπορεί και να καταψύξει φρέσκα τρόφιμα, αντί να συντηρεί μόνο ήδη κατεψυγμένα.

🧩
ΑΡΧΑΡΙΟΙ

Το codec Bluetooth στα ακουστικά δεν αρκεί για καλύτερο ήχο ή λιγότερη καθυστέρηση

Κινητό και ακουστικά πρέπει να υποστηρίζουν τον ίδιο κωδικοποιητή. Η επιλογή του μπορεί να επηρεάσει τον συγχρονισμό ήχου και εικόνας, αλλά στις κλήσεις το κλασικό Bluetooth χρησιμοποιεί διαφορετική λειτουργία.

ΚΑΛΟ ΝΑ ΞΕΡΕΙΣ

Τι καταγράφει η smart τηλεόρασή σου και πώς περιορίζεις το ACR;

Η αναγνώριση όσων παίζουν στην οθόνη, τα δεδομένα χρήσης και οι εξατομικευμένες διαφημίσεις έχουν ξεχωριστές ρυθμίσεις. Για να περιορίσεις τη συλλογή, δεν αρκεί να επαναφέρεις το διαφημιστικό αναγνωριστικό.

ΚΑΛΟ ΝΑ ΞΕΡΕΙΣ

Στα γυναικεία sneakers η όψη της σόλας δεν αρκεί για να κρίνεις το κράτημα στα βρεγμένα

Το υλικό και τα αυλάκια βοηθούν να αξιολογήσεις τη σόλα στο κατάστημα. Για πιο συγκεκριμένη εικόνα, χρειάζεται να ξέρεις αν το μοντέλο έχει δοκιμαστεί και σε ποια επιφάνεια.

ΚΑΛΟ ΝΑ ΞΕΡΕΙΣ

Ο M6 έφτασε στα Mac αλλά δεν εκτοπίζει τον M5 Pro

Στη σύγκριση Mac mini της Macstadium, ο M6 προηγείται στην επίδοση ενός πυρήνα, αλλά ο M5 Pro κερδίζει στις βαριές παράλληλες εργασίες. Η κυκλοφορία ισχυρότερων M6 παραμένει αβέβαιη.

🧩
ΚΑΛΟ ΝΑ ΞΕΡΕΙΣ

Τι κάνει πραγματικά το Wi-Fi σε ένα πλυντήριο πιάτων;

Ο έλεγχος από το κινητό μπορεί να σου γλιτώσει διαδρομές στην κουζίνα, αλλά η απομακρυσμένη εκκίνηση χρειάζεται προετοιμασία και οι διαθέσιμες λειτουργίες εξαρτώνται από το μοντέλο.

ΜΥΘΟΙ

Το σκοτεινό θέμα γλιτώνει μπαταρία στις OLED, όχι στις LCD

Η διαφορά εξαρτάται και από τη φωτεινότητα. Στη μελέτη του Purdue σε κινητά Android με OLED, το όφελος ήταν μικρό σε μέτρια φωτεινότητα και πολύ μεγαλύτερο στο μέγιστο.

🧩
VS

Το νέο Apple TV 4K φέρνει A19 και μικρόφωνα για το Siri

Ο φωνητικός έλεγχος χωρίς τηλεχειριστήριο ξεχωρίζει στη νέα γενιά, αλλά το Siri AI ξεκινά μόνο στα αγγλικά και σε οκτώ χώρες, χωρίς επιβεβαιωμένη διαθεσιμότητα στην Ελλάδα.

🧩
ΚΑΛΟ ΝΑ ΞΕΡΕΙΣ

Γιατί δύο καλώδια USB-C που μοιάζουν ίδια δεν φορτίζουν το ίδιο γρήγορα

Η ένδειξη ισχύος δεν αρκεί για να διαλέξεις καλώδιο. Μετρά και το ρεύμα που υποστηρίζει, μαζί με τις απαιτήσεις του κινητού και του φορτιστή σου.

🧩
ΟΔΗΓΟΣ

Ο θορυβώδης ανεμιστήρας στο PS5 δεν σημαίνει πάντα βλάβη

Η θέση στο έπιπλο και η σκόνη είναι οι πρώτοι έλεγχοι για κάθε έκδοση του PS5. Μια προειδοποίηση θερμοκρασίας, όμως, χρειάζεται διαφορετική αντιμετώπιση.
